message: Hi, my kid Jai is 12 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! We have a Teens and Preteens program for ages 10-15 that combines Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and Judo. Perfect for Jai. The first class is always free, no commitment. Would you like to get him signed up for a trial?
Yes, I’d love to sign Jai up for a trial class! When is the next available time?
Awesome! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?

Great, thanks Tester! Can I grab your email address? That way I can send you the confirmation and class detwils.
*details
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! And just to confirm, what's Jai's full name and date of birth? That helps us get him in the right class group.
Jai's full name is Jai Garnet, and his birthday is May 5, 2014.

Perfect! Jai is all set for the Teens program. Here are the next available times for his free trial class:

Tuesday 7/8 at 5:15 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 5:15 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 9:00 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday, July 8 at 5:15 PM. Thank you!

I'm sorry, that slot just filled up! The nearest available times are:

Tuesday 7/7 at 5:15 PM (tomorrow)
Thursday 7/9 at 5:15 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 9:00 AM

Which of these works for you?
Let’s go with Thursday, July 9 at 5:15 PM. Thanks for the update!
Perfect! Jai is all booked for Thursday, July 9 at 5:15 PM for his free trial class. We're at 220 Church St in Northport. Just come in comfortable workout clothes. Looking forward to seeing you both!
